create_AlignedBox2d: create an AlignedBox2d bounding box with left, top, right, bottom coordinates
pad_AlignedBox2d: pad an AlignedBox2d bounding box by extending width and height on all four sides
clip_AlignedBox2d: clip an AlignedBox2d bounding box to fit within a specified boundary box
convert_AlignedBox2d_array_ltrb: convert an AlignedBox2d bounding box to a numpy array in left, top, right, bottom format
convert_AlignedBox2d_array_ltwh: convert an AlignedBox2d bounding box to a numpy array in left, top, width, height format
